author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
title: Little Lord Fauntleroy, Chapters XIV–XV, in St. Nicholas, Vol. XIII, No. 12, October 1886
edition: Original English serial text in St. Nicholas, volume XIII, number 12 (New York: The Century Co., October 1886), pp. 884–890; Project Gutenberg no. 76024 transcription. The magazine masthead explicitly prints October 1886 and copyright 1886. Selected prose paragraphs are retained whole and in order. Illustration captions, images, running page numbers, chapter headings, and THE END label are omitted. HTML entities are decoded, inline typographic emphasis is represented as plain text, and prose line-wrap whitespace is normalized; original spelling, dialect, wording, punctuation, and paragraph boundaries are preserved. The library text holds Burnett’s whole final installment from this issue: its serial title as a level-1 heading, the byline, Chapters XIV. and XV. under level-2 headings with every paragraph, and the closing THE END.; the issue’s other contributions and its illustrations and captions are not included.

rights.basis: These original English serial chapters were published in the explicitly dated October 1886 issue of St. Nicholas, before 1931, and are in the US public domain as of 2026. Project Gutenberg no. 76024 independently labels the issue Public domain in the USA. No modern introduction, adaptation, or illustrations are included.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg HTML (pg76024-images.html from the aleph.pglaf.org mirror), the whole October 1886 issue, parsed with Python's html.parser; only the LITTLE LORD FAUNTLEROY. installment was taken, from its title heading up to the next contribution (OCTOBER.). Within it, the illustrations, page-number markers and rules were dropped; the title became the level-1 heading, Chapter XIV. and Chapter XV. level-2 headings, and the byline, every HTML paragraph (the two that open after a printed section break carry no separate break marker) and the closing THE END. became paragraph blocks with whitespace folded to single spaces; italics rendered as plain text; typographic quotation marks and em dashes kept as transcribed. Every Grade 3 night from this installment was located block for block.

scope.note: Holds only Frances Hodgson Burnett’s Little Lord Fauntleroy installment (Chapters XIV and XV) from the October 1886 St. Nicholas issue; the issue’s other contributions by other writers, its departments and its illustrations are not included.
